The function's TABLE_NAME is 'missing-table' in both the live configuration and the SAM template, and the template hard-codes it rather than referencing CartTable (!Ref CartTable). The CrudApiRole grants PutItem only on CartTable.Arn, so the IAM policy never covers the table the function actually calls. The live configuration matches the template, so this is an intended-state defect in the IaC rather than configuration drift. The live CrudApiFunction was last modified at 22:45:15, just before the window opened, which is the deployment that introduced this value. Other functions show no errors in the window.
